label ← CONCAT("Hello, ", name)
DISPLAY(label)
DISPLAY(SUBSTRING("COMPUTING", 1, 4))

hasMaterials ← INPUT()
ready ← (minutes >= 30) AND hasMaterials
DISPLAY(ready)
DISPLAY(NOT ready)

title: L13 · Total three study sessions
code:
total ← 0
REPEAT 3 TIMES
{
  minutes ← INPUT()
  total ← total + minutes
}
DISPLAY(total)
prompt: Trace total after each input. Extend the program to display the mean after the loop.

title: L14 · Stop at a sentinel
code:
total ← 0
minutes ← INPUT()
REPEAT UNTIL (minutes = -1)
{
  total ← total + minutes
  minutes ← INPUT()
}
DISPLAY(total)
prompt: Use nonnegative minutes and end with -1. Predict what happens if the first input is -1. The sentinel is not added.
